❓ FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers to common questions about our taxi and travel services.

The taxi fare from Lucknow to Ayodhya starts at ₹12/km for a Sedan (approx. ₹1,680 for 140 km one-way). SUV and Innova options are also available at ₹15/km and ₹18/km respectively. Toll and parking charges are extra, charged at actuals. Minimum outstation booking is 250 km/day.
You can book a tempo traveller by calling us directly at +916387301763, messaging on WhatsApp, or using the fare calculator on our website. We offer 12-seater, 17-seater, and 26-seater tempo travellers for groups, pilgrimages, and corporate outings.
Our premium wedding fleet includes Sedan, SUV, Innova Crysta, Innova Hycross, Fortuner, Honda City with Sunroof, Verna, BMW, Audi, Jaguar, and Mercedes. Local wedding packages start at ₹7,500 for a sedan, going up to ₹35,000 for a Mercedes.
No. Toll, parking, and border tax charges are never included in our quoted rates. These are always charged at actuals and communicated upfront. This applies to all bookings — standard, wedding, and station transfers.
The minimum booking distance for outstation trips is 250 km per day. For local bookings within Lucknow, the minimum is 120 km or 12 hours, whichever comes first. Kilometres are measured garage-to-garage.
Yes. A night charge applies for travel before 6:30 AM or after 9:30 PM. Standard bookings: ₹300. Wedding bookings: ₹500. Premium sedan (sunroof) bookings: ₹500. This is a one-time charge per trip, not per hour.
